correctness.rationale: Let y_i be center receipts from leaf i, x_i=q−y_i, C=∑y_i. Center-to-leaf EFX becomes C+min(y_i)≥q−1. Leaf-to-center EFX with some center bundle item of zero value forces y_i≤floor(q/2); only when other y_j all vanish does y_i≤(q+1)/2, with feasible extra orientations only at q=3, giving 3b. Each y_i has binomial(q,y_i) labeled realizations. For b≥q−1 all disallowed small sums ≤q−2 include a zero component, giving polynomial correction; binomial symmetry yields exact parity rates. Independently brute-forced complete all-goods EFX for eight small (b,q) against the finite formula.
